tail:
Batch 28 is authored. The A and B pages and six draft items are in place, with item levels **1, 2, 4, 1, 1, 5**. All six Step 1 records are current and `ready`; that records authoring readiness, not independent proof approval.

The normalization lemma now states and proves the bounded-region Poisson sector density, normalization, kernel measurability, consistency, and DLR conditional-law equivalence. The B page has complete counterexamples, including the fixed-activity pressure calculation with explicit SI scaling. Current batch 27 supplier interfaces were checked; its definitions and postulate remain drafts and are used only in their stated roles.

**Checks:** proof layout passed for 6 items and 24 steps; precheck, focused dependency checks, rendering, strict proof contracts, source coverage, and fetch checks passed. The scoped dependency graph across batches 26–28 passed for 60 items. Source coverage uses [Jansen’s complete lecture notes](https://www.math.lmu.de/~jansen/gibbspp.pdf) and [Dereudre’s complete mini-course](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1701.08105); Dereudre’s stationarity restriction is recorded.

Run-wide gates remain blocked by unfinished inventories and dependency-level issues in other batches. The shared batch-level dependency record also reports a stale input hash; it still lists batch 28 at level 2 requiring batch 27, and I left it unchanged for the owner.
